Wren explicitly offers supplies for the road and the player acknowledges the host. A useful once-only reward fulfills that practical purpose; no unrelated chest or unresolved mystery is used as a substitute payoff. This is a small teaching beat, not an approval of the archived Fernling mystery or a professional vertical slice.
